files.source:
name: Issue54 original CTEAS TERREL genuine same-TIFF parity (manual only)

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, reopened, synchronize, ready_for_review]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/issue54-original-terrel-manual.yml'
      - 'scripts/s2g/p1_original_actions_replay.py'
      - 'scripts/s2g/tests/test_p1_original_actions_replay.py'
      - 'scripts/s2g/tests/test_p1_original_legacy_tiff.py'
      - 'scripts/s2g/p1_original_coord_probe.py'
      - 'scripts/s2g/tests/test_p1_original_coord_probe.py'
      - 'scripts/s2g/p1_original_cpp_probe.py'
      - 'scripts/s2g/tests/test_p1_original_cpp_probe.py'
      - 'scripts/s2g/p1_original_hit_diagnostics.py'
      - 'scripts/s2g/tests/test_p1_original_hit_diagnostics.py'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      route:
        description: Original TERREL vs same selected real TIFF and native P1
        required: true
        type: choice
        options:
          - P1_A_90M_LOCAL
          - P1_B_30M_DOWNLOAD

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: issue54-original-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ inputs.route || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  synthetic-original-evidence-contract-only:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 12
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
          lfs: false
      - name: Install raster metadata dependencies for synthetic Int16 TIFF only
        run: python3 -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check 'PyYAML>=6,<7' 'rasterio>=1.3,<2' 'numpy>=1.23,<3' 'pyproj>=3.4,<4'
      - name: Check structural integrity and lossless TIFF bytes; no proprietary original
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -m unittest -v scripts.s2g.tests.test_p1_original_actions_replay scripts.s2g.tests.test_p1_original_legacy_tiff scripts.s2g.tests.test_p1_original_hit_diagnostics scripts.s2g.tests.test_p1_original_coord_probe scripts.s2g.tests.test_p1_original_cpp_probe
          python3 -m py_compile scripts/s2g/p1_original_actions_replay.py
          echo 'ORIGINAL_TERREL_CONTRACT_SOFTWARE=PASS_REAL_ORIGINAL_NOT_RUN'

  genuine-original-vs-native:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 70
    env:
      ROUTE: ${{ inputs.route }}
      OPENTOPOGRAPHY_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENTOPOGRAPHY_API_KEY }}
      CTEAS_ORIGINAL_COMMIT: dfad99a78ed84d655e21411c9d25eb0d2583bf13
    steps:
      - name: Checkout selected CTEAS-next P1 source and comparator
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          lfs: false
          persist-credentials: true
      - name: Checkout exact original CTEAS source into separate disposable directory
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: RRain001/CTEAS
          ref: dfad99a78ed84d655e21411c9d25eb0d2583bf13
          path: cteas-original-vendor
          lfs: false
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Validate exact frozen original source revision, not modified/repackaged
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git -C cteas-original-vendor rev-parse HEAD)" = "$CTEAS_ORIGINAL_COMMIT"
          test -s cteas-original-vendor/engine/vendor/src/TERREL_v7.0.0_L141010/terrel.for
          test -s cteas-original-vendor/engine/vendor/src/TERREL_v7.0.0_L141010/terrel.inp
          echo 'CTEAS_PINNED_ORIGINAL_TERREL_SOURCE_PRESENT=YES'
      - name: Install Fortran compiler, native build, and actual raster source dependencies
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends cmake g++ gfortran libgdal-dev git-lfs
          python3 -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check 'PyYAML>=6,<7' 'rasterio>=1.3,<2' 'numpy>=1.23,<3' 'pyproj>=3.4,<4'
          python3 -c 'from pyproj import Transformer; print("P1_ORIGINAL_COORD_FORENSIC_PROJ_DEPENDENCY=OK")'
      - name: Materialize only the true two SRTM90m tiles for source A
        if: inputs.route == 'P1_A_90M_LOCAL'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git lfs install --local
          git lfs pull --include='calpuff_terrain_and_landuse_data/china_srtm/srtm_59_06.tif,calpuff_terrain_and_landuse_data/china_srtm/srtm_60_06.tif' --exclude=''
          test "$(stat -c '%s' calpuff_terrain_and_landuse_data/china_srtm/srtm_59_06.tif)" -eq 72096675
          test "$(stat -c '%s' calpuff_terrain_and_landuse_data/china_srtm/srtm_60_06.tif)" -eq 72096675
      - name: Build unchanged audited C++ P1 (same input as original replay)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cmake -S native_cpp/p1 -B "$RUNNER_TEMP/p1-issue54-original-native-build" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
          cmake --build "$RUNNER_TEMP/p1-issue54-original-native-build" --parallel 2
          ctest --test-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/p1-issue54-original-native-build" --output-on-failure
      - name: Generate same real source and native P1 in new case folder
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -m scripts.s2g.p1_real_actions_case \
            --root "$RUNNER_TEMP/p1-issue54-original-replay" \
            --route "$ROUTE" \
            --tif-dir "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/calpuff_terrain_and_landuse_data/china_srtm" \
            --binary "$RUNNER_TEMP/p1-issue54-original-native-build/cteas_p1_terrain_case" \
            --report "$RUNNER_TEMP/p1-issue54-native-source-evidence.json"
          echo 'REAL_SRTM_SOURCE_AND_NATIVE_REPRODUCED=YES'
      - name: Compile untouched TERREL 7.0.0 and compare same TIFF against native
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -m scripts.s2g.p1_original_actions_replay \
            --case-root "$RUNNER_TEMP/p1-issue54-original-replay/issue54_p1_seam_2022" \
            --cteas-checkout "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/cteas-original-vendor" \
            --native-binary "$RUNNER_TEMP/p1-issue54-original-native-build/cteas_p1_terrain_case" \
            --route "$ROUTE" \
            --report "$RUNNER_TEMP/p1-issue54-original-parity-evidence.json"
          echo 'NUMERIC_PASS_PROVISIONAL_ONLY_INDEPENDENT_AUDIT_STILL_REQUIRED'
      - name: Upload SHA and numeric summary ONLY; never raw DEM, vendor or control
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: issue54-original-parity-${{ inputs.route }}-metadata-only
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/p1-issue54-native-source-evidence.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/p1-issue54-original-parity-evidence.json
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 30

# Issue #54: independent direct C++ pixel lineage after original/numeric FAIL

The 2026-10-18 genuine pinned original TERREL vs C++ for both real SRTM
90m and SRTMGL1 30m is still strict `NUMERIC_FAIL`.
[Issue evidence](https://github.com/RRain001/CTEAS-next/issues/54#issuecomment-6251967174)
shows original per-pixel COORDLIB/GLOBE and a Python pyproj proxy differ
in coordinates/near-cell-boundary assignment. The old pyproj proxy
happens to reproduce **total accepted native points** for both cases,
but is not direct C++ instruction-level evidence.

This PR upgrades the **forensic-only** post-failure process with direct
C++ GDAL/PROJ+REAL4 tracing.

- First, run the original **unchanged** CTEAS-pinned TERREL Fortran,
  original data/source hashes, and the unchanged formal C++ P1; invoke
  the existing independent strict DAT/SAV/CSV comparison. Only the
  formal result establishes NUMERIC_PASS_PROVISIONAL or NUMERIC_FAIL.
- Only on formal `NUMERIC_FAIL`, the forensic probe makes a **temporary
  copy of the current native_cpp project** in the Actions runner scratch
  directory, adds a small pixel log to the copied
  `src/geo/terrain_grid.cpp`, and compiles a separate executable.
  The formal production native binary and original source repository
  remain untouched.
- Run the scratch-native C++ on the exact same verified Compression=1
  Int16/NoData WGS84 TIFF as the pinned original Fortran, with identical
  UTM zone, hemisphere, grid origin/dimensions and cell size.
- Match original `LOADTIFF` pixel (i,j), projected (x,y), CELLIND (ix,iy)
  directly to the instrumented native C++ pixel (i,j), projected (x,y),
  CELLIND (ix,iy). This removes dependence on the Python approximation.
  Compare both-inside model-cell assignment differences separately from
  source pixels outside grid, report N/S vs E/W reassignment, accepted
  point totals, and at most 20 **model-cell** examples.
- The **full** per-pixel trace, arbitrary field values, TIFF, vendor
  source/binary, and historical original output remain private and
  ephemeral, never uploaded as Actions artifacts. Only categorical
  summary/digests are uploaded. Scratch instrumented sources are NEVER
  used in the official physical-parity acceptance.
- The diagnostic result may be more convincing about the physical
  root cause, but it **cannot itself turn numeric FAIL into PASS**.
  The eventual corrected, reviewed production C++ algorithm must
  independently pass both original source cases plus frozen Hefei
  regression without changing strict scientific tolerances.

Normal PR CI uses only tiny synthetic line fixtures. Both real 90m/30m
diagnostics remain manually dispatched `workflow_dispatch` on main,
user-authorized via owner issue comments.

"""#54 forensic-only original pixel lineage probe, never a scientific solver.

Make a scratch diagnostic copy of pinned original TERREL FORTRAN (original
source/normal verifier untouched), trace original LOADTIFF -> GLOBE -> CELLIND
pixel coordinates/indices and contrast with the native GDAL/PROJ algorithm.
Only bounded aggregate diagnostics are written to Actions metadata.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
import json
import math
import shutil
import subprocess

class CoordinateProbeError(ValueError):
    pass

OPEN_ANCHOR="      open(unit=500,file='numpts.dat')"
POINT_ANCHOR="            call SAVEELEV(xdist,ydist,dels,elev)"
TRACE_OPEN="      open(unit=501,file='p1_original_coords.txt',status='new')"
TRACE_POINT="""            call cellind(xdist,ydist,dels,ixprobe,iyprobe,
     &                       ixpprobe,iypprobe)
            write(501,*) i,j,ixprobe,iyprobe,xdist,ydist"""
TRACE_CLOSE="      close(501)"


def diagnostic_copy(original:Path,dest:Path)->None:
    if dest.exists() or dest.is_symlink():
        raise CoordinateProbeError("diagnostic source must not overwrite evidence")
    content=original.read_text(encoding="latin-1")
    if content.count(OPEN_ANCHOR)!=1 or content.count(POINT_ANCHOR)!=1:
        raise CoordinateProbeError("historical original pixel-hook anchors changed")
    if TRACE_OPEN in content or TRACE_POINT in content:
        raise CoordinateProbeError("original source is already instrumented")
    content=content.replace(OPEN_ANCHOR,OPEN_ANCHOR+"\n"+TRACE_OPEN,1)
    content=content.replace(POINT_ANCHOR,TRACE_POINT+"\n"+POINT_ANCHOR,1)
    # Unit 501 is automatically closed when original exits. Any duplicate
    # pixel hooks, missing original call or source modification fail closed.
    if content.count(POINT_ANCHOR)!=1 or content.count(TRACE_OPEN)!=1:
        raise CoordinateProbeError("invalid forensic TERREL source hook")
    dest.write_text(content,encoding="latin-1")


def _cell_index(east_m:float,north_m:float,grid:dict)->tuple[int,int]:
    """Mirror native C++ REAL*4 xllm/scale/CELLIND, not the original trace."""
    import numpy as np
    f=np.float32
    xll=f(f(float(grid["xrefkm"]))*f(1000.0))
    yll=f(f(float(grid["yrefkm"]))*f(1000.0))
    scale=f(f(1.0)/f(float(grid["dgridkm"])*1000.0))
    xi=f(f(f(east_m)-xll)*scale)
    yi=f(f(f(north_m)-yll)*scale)
    # Native truncation toward zero plus +1 for nonnegative indices.
    def idx(a,n):
        if not math.isfinite(float(a)) or a < -1 or a>=n:
            return 0
        out=int(a)+(1 if a>=0 else 0)
        return out if 1<=out<=n else 0
    return idx(xi,grid["nx"]),idx(yi,grid["ny"])


def diagnose_trace(*,trace:Path,selected_tif:Path,grid:dict,
                   max_records:int=250_000)->dict:
    import numpy as np
    import rasterio
    from pyproj import Transformer

    if max_records<=0 or max_records>250_000:
        raise CoordinateProbeError("invalid trace record limit")
    zone=grid["zone"]
    if type(zone) is not int or not 1<=zone<=60 or grid["hemisphere"] not in ("N","S"):
        raise CoordinateProbeError("invalid projection reference")
    with rasterio.open(selected_tif) as source:
        if source.crs.to_epsg()!=4326:
            raise CoordinateProbeError("trace requires WGS84 GeoTIFF")
        tf=source.transform
        if tf.b != 0 or tf.d != 0:
            raise CoordinateProbeError("trace requires north-up source")
        xorg=np.float32(tf.c+tf.a*0.5)
        yorg=np.float32(tf.f+tf.e*0.5)
        ddx=np.float32(tf.a)
        ddy=np.float32(tf.e)
        width,height=source.width,source.height
    epsg=(32700 if grid["hemisphere"]=="S" else 32600)+zone
    proj=Transformer.from_crs("EPSG:4326",f"EPSG:{epsg}",always_xy=True)
    raw_factor=float(np.float32(0.001))
    total=coordinate_disagreements=cell_disagreements=0
    original_in=proxy_in=both_in=both_out=original_only=proxy_only=0
    all_offsets_x=[];all_offsets_y=[]
    grid_shift=Counter()
    first_disagree=[]
    max_e=max_n=0.
    max_pixel_err=0.
    with trace.open(encoding="utf-8",errors="strict") as f:
        for line in f:
            if not line.strip():
                continue
            total+=1
            if total>max_records:
                raise CoordinateProbeError("original pixel trace exceeds bounded rows")
            parts=line.split()
            if len(parts)!=6:
                raise CoordinateProbeError("unexpected original pixel trace shape")
            try:
                i,j,ix,iy=map(int,parts[:4])
                old_x,old_y=map(lambda v:float(v.replace("D","E")),parts[4:])
            except (ValueError,OverflowError) as exc:
                raise CoordinateProbeError("malformed original pixel coordinates") from exc
            if not (1<=i<=width and 1<=j<=height) or not all(
                  math.isfinite(v) for v in (old_x,old_y)):
                raise CoordinateProbeError("forensic index/coordinate not finite or out of bounds")
            lon=float(np.float32(xorg+np.float32(i-1)*ddx))
            lat=float(np.float32(yorg+np.float32(j-1)*ddy))
            xm,ym=proj.transform(lon,lat)
            # Original native path: projected metre * REAL*4 0.001,
            # rounded to REAL*4 kilometres, then * REAL*4 1000.
            native_x=float(np.float32(np.float32(xm*raw_factor)*np.float32(1000.0)))
            native_y=float(np.float32(np.float32(ym*raw_factor)*np.float32(1000.0)))
            dx=old_x-native_x;dy=old_y-native_y
            max_e=max(max_e,abs(dx));max_n=max(max_n,abs(dy))
            if dx or dy:coordinate_disagreements+=1
            native_i,native_j=_cell_index(native_x,native_y,grid)
            inside_old=(1<=ix<=grid["nx"] and 1<=iy<=grid["ny"])
            inside_proxy=(native_i>0 and native_j>0)
            original_in+=int(inside_old)
            proxy_in+=int(inside_proxy)
            if inside_old and inside_proxy:
                both_in+=1
                if (ix,iy)!=(native_i,native_j):
                    cell_disagreements+=1
                    diffx=ix-native_i;diffy=iy-native_j
                    grid_shift[("E_W" if diffx else "NO_E_W",
                                "N_S" if diffy else "NO_N_S")]+=1
                    if len(first_disagree)<20:
                        first_disagree.append({
                          "original_grid_indices":[ix,iy],
                          "proj_proxy_grid_indices":[native_i,native_j],
                          "original_minus_proj_east_m":round(dx,6),
                          "original_minus_proj_north_m":round(dy,6),
                        })
            elif inside_old:
                original_only+=1
            elif inside_proxy:
                proxy_only+=1
            else:
                both_out+=1
            all_offsets_x.append(abs(dx));all_offsets_y.append(abs(dy))
    if total==0:
        raise CoordinateProbeError("empty independent original pixel trace")
    def percentile(vals,p):
        vals=sorted(vals)
        return round(vals[min(len(vals)-1,math.floor((len(vals)-1)*p))],6)
    return {
      "schema_version":"p1-original-pixel-coordinate-proxy-v1",
      "status":"DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY_NOT_SCIENCE_ACCEPTED",
      "trace_records":total,
      "coordinate_records_differ_from_proj_proxy":coordinate_disagreements,
      "original_vs_proj_proxy_cell_mismatches_BOTH_INSIDE":cell_disagreements,
      "original_inside_hits":original_in,
      "proj_proxy_inside_hits":proxy_in,
      "both_inside":both_in,
      "both_outside":both_out,
      "original_inside_only":original_only,
      "proj_proxy_inside_only":proxy_only,
      "inside_outside_classifications_sum_to_trace":(
          both_in+both_out+original_only+proxy_only==total),
      "max_abs_easting_difference_m":round(max_e,6),
      "max_abs_northing_difference_m":round(max_n,6),
      "p95_abs_easting_difference_m":percentile(all_offsets_x,.95),
      "p95_abs_northing_difference_m":percentile(all_offsets_y,.95),
      "cell_mismatch_axes":{"/".join(k):v for k,v in grid_shift.items()},
      "first20_inside_grid_cell_disagreements_only":first_disagree,
      "original_source_used":"CTEAS_PINNED_TERREL_SCRATCH_INSTRUMENTED_COPY",
      "native_comparison_basis":"GDAL_PROJ_PYPROJ_FLOAT32_PROXY_NOT_INSTRUMENTED_CXX",
      "pixel_trace_artifact_uploaded":False,
      "science_acceptance":"NOT_ACCEPTED"
    }


def execute_original_diagnostic(*,checkout:Path,vendor:Path,selected:Path,
                                grid:dict,workspace:Path)->dict:
    """A separate scratch copy; must not change original production evidence."""
    import sys
    from scripts.s2g.p1_original_actions_replay import _invoke,prepare_control
    forensic=workspace/"forensic_pixel_probe"
    forensic.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    patched=forensic/"terrel_forensic_only.for"
    diagnostic_copy(vendor/"terrel.for",patched)
    aliases=workspace/"original_build/aliases"
    if not aliases.is_dir():
        raise CoordinateProbeError("original compiler include aliases not staged")
    exe=forensic/"terrel-debug.x"
    args=["gfortran","-std=legacy","-fno-automatic","-fno-align-commons",
          "-fallow-argument-mismatch","-O0","-ffixed-line-length-none",
          "-I"+str(aliases),"-I"+str(vendor),str(patched),
          "-o",str(exe)]
    compiled=_invoke(args,cwd=forensic,seconds=180,logprefix=forensic/"compile-debug")
    if compiled["returncode"]!=0 or not exe.is_file():
        raise CoordinateProbeError("instrumented independent source compilation failed")
    ctrl=prepare_control(vendor,checkout,forensic,selected,grid)
    original_dir=ctrl.parent
    out=_invoke([str(exe),ctrl.name],cwd=original_dir,seconds=300,
                logprefix=forensic/"run-debug")
    trace=original_dir/"p1_original_coords.txt"
    if out["returncode"]!=0 or not trace.is_file():
        raise CoordinateProbeError("forensic-only original execution failed")
    result=diagnose_trace(trace=trace,selected_tif=selected,grid=grid)
    # Direct, separate instrumented C++ binary uses the exact same source
    # TIFF and grid. This is stronger than the existing Python projection
    # proxy but remains forensic only, never accepted physical evidence.
    try:
        from scripts.s2g.p1_original_cpp_probe import run_direct_cpp_probe
        result["native_CXX_direct_pixel_lineage"]=run_direct_cpp_probe(
            forensic_root=forensic,original_trace=trace,
            selected_tif=selected,grid=grid)
    except (OSError,ValueError,TimeoutError,subprocess.SubprocessError) as exc:
        result["native_CXX_direct_pixel_lineage"]={
            "status":"BLOCKED_DIRECT_CXX_FORENSIC",
            "reason_type":type(exc).__name__,
            "science_acceptance":"NOT_ACCEPTED"}
    return result

"""#54 scratch-only native C++ pixel-coordinate instrumentation.

Never instrument the production native C++ binary. Build a temporary
diagnostic copy, feed the IDENTICAL real GeoTIFF/grid and compare its actual
GDAL/PROJ REAL*4 pixel coordinates/CELLIND decisions against a separate
instrumented, pinned original TERREL scratch copy. Upload only aggregates.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from collections import Counter
import math
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess

class CppCoordinateProbeError(ValueError):
    pass

HEAD_INCLUDE="#include <memory>"
TRACE_INIT="  std::vector<float> sum(cells,0.0f);"
TRACE_POINT="    const auto cell=cell_index_terrel(projected_x,projected_y,spec);"


def instrument_cpp(source:Path,destination:Path)->None:
    if destination.exists() or destination.is_symlink():
        raise CppCoordinateProbeError("diagnostic C++ destination already exists")
    text=source.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    for anchor in (HEAD_INCLUDE,TRACE_INIT,TRACE_POINT):
        if text.count(anchor)!=1:
            raise CppCoordinateProbeError("native C++ pixel trace anchor not unique")
    text=text.replace(HEAD_INCLUDE,
                      HEAD_INCLUDE+"\n#include <fstream>\n#include <iomanip>",1)
    text=text.replace(TRACE_INIT,TRACE_INIT+"""
  std::ofstream pixel_trace("p1_native_cpp_coords.txt");
  if(!pixel_trace.is_open())
    throw std::runtime_error("forensic C++ trace output cannot be created");
  pixel_trace << std::setprecision(12);""",1)
    text=text.replace(TRACE_POINT,TRACE_POINT+"""
    pixel_trace << (i+1) << ' ' << (j+1) << ' '
                << (cell ? cell->first+1 : 0) << ' '
                << (cell ? cell->second+1 : 0) << ' '
                << projected_x << ' ' << projected_y << '\\n';""",1)
    if text.count("pixel_trace << (i+1)")!=1:
        raise CppCoordinateProbeError("C++ instrumentation insertion malformed")
    destination.write_text(text,encoding="utf-8")


def direct_trace_summary(*,original_trace:Path,cpp_trace:Path,
                         grid:dict,max_pixels:int=250_000)->dict:
    if not 0<max_pixels<=250_000:
        raise CppCoordinateProbeError("invalid forensic trace memory budget")
    nx,ny=grid["nx"],grid["ny"]
    if not (1<=nx<=100_000 and 1<=ny<=100_000):
        raise CppCoordinateProbeError("invalid grid dimensions")
    def parse(line):
        values=line.split()
        if len(values)!=6:
            raise CppCoordinateProbeError("forensic pixel trace record has wrong columns")
        try:
            i,j,ix,iy=map(int,values[:4])
            east,north=map(lambda s:float(s.replace("D","E")),values[4:])
        except (ValueError,OverflowError) as exc:
            raise CppCoordinateProbeError("forensic pixel coordinates malformed") from exc
        if not (i>=1 and j>=1 and math.isfinite(east) and math.isfinite(north)):
            raise CppCoordinateProbeError("forensic pixel trace invalid source index or projection")
        return (i,j,ix,iy,east,north)
    def inside(ix,iy):
        return 1<=ix<=nx and 1<=iy<=ny
    cpp={}
    cpp_in=0
    with cpp_trace.open(encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for line in f:
            if not line.strip():
                continue
            row=parse(line)
            key=row[:2]
            if len(cpp)>=max_pixels or key in cpp:
                raise CppCoordinateProbeError("C++ pixel trace over budget or duplicate indexes")
            cpp[key]=row[2:]
            cpp_in+=int(inside(*row[2:4]))
    if not cpp:
        raise CppCoordinateProbeError("empty C++ trace")
    total=old_in=cpp_in_orig=both_in=original_only=cpp_only=both_out=mismatch=0
    dxmax=dymax=0.
    axes=Counter()
    examples=[]
    with original_trace.open(encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for line in f:
            if not line.strip():
                continue
            total+=1
            if total>max_pixels:
                raise CppCoordinateProbeError("original pixel trace over budget")
            i,j,ix,iy,east,north=parse(line)
            try:
                newix,newiy,newx,newy=cpp.pop((i,j))
            except KeyError as exc:
                raise CppCoordinateProbeError(
                    "original coordinate trace pixel absent from native TIFF") from exc
            dx=east-newx;dy=north-newy
            dxmax=max(dxmax,abs(dx));dymax=max(dymax,abs(dy))
            old_ok=inside(ix,iy);cpp_ok=inside(newix,newiy)
            old_in+=int(old_ok);cpp_in_orig+=int(cpp_ok)
            if old_ok and cpp_ok:
                both_in+=1
                if (ix,iy)!=(newix,newiy):
                    mismatch+=1
                    axis=("E_W" if ix!=newix else "NO_E_W",
                          "N_S" if iy!=newiy else "NO_N_S")
                    axes[axis]+=1
                    if len(examples)<20:
                        examples.append({
                            "original_model_grid":[ix,iy],
                            "actual_CXX_model_grid":[newix,newiy],
                            "original_minus_CXX_easting_m":round(dx,6),
                            "original_minus_CXX_northing_m":round(dy,6)
                        })
            elif old_ok:
                original_only+=1
            elif cpp_ok:
                cpp_only+=1
            else:
                both_out+=1
    return {
      "status":"DIRECT_SCRATCH_CXX_ORIGINAL_COORD_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY",
      "traced_original_pixels":total,
      "native_total_trace_pixels":len(cpp)+total,
      "original_trace_accepted":old_in,
      "real_native_CXX_trace_accepted":cpp_in,
      "native_CXX_accepted_within_original_trace":cpp_in_orig,
      "both_inside":both_in,
      "both_outside":both_out,
      "original_inside_only":original_only,
      "native_CXX_inside_only":cpp_only,
      "different_cells_among_both_inside":mismatch,
      "model_cell_assignment_axes":{"/".join(k):v for k,v in axes.items()},
      "max_abs_original_minus_CXX_easting_m":round(dxmax,6),
      "max_abs_original_minus_CXX_northing_m":round(dymax,6),
      "first20_actual_CXX_original_cell_differences":examples,
      "scratch_debug_sources_used_only":True,
      "full_pixel_trace_uploaded":False,
      "science_acceptance":"NOT_ACCEPTED"
    }


def run_direct_cpp_probe(*,forensic_root:Path,original_trace:Path,
                         selected_tif:Path,grid:dict)->dict:
    from scripts.s2g.p1_original_actions_replay import _invoke
    repo_root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    source=repo_root/"native_cpp"
    copied=forensic_root/"native_cpp_diagnostic_only"
    if not (source/"p1/CMakeLists.txt").is_file():
        raise CppCoordinateProbeError("audited native C++ source unavailable")
    shutil.copytree(source,copied,symlinks=False)
    original=copied/"src/geo/terrain_grid.cpp"
    replacement=copied/"src/geo/terrain_grid_probe_only.cpp"
    instrument_cpp(original,replacement)
    original.unlink()
    replacement.rename(original)
    build=forensic_root/"cpp_build"
    compile_config=_invoke(["cmake","-S",str(copied/"p1"),"-B",str(build),
                             "-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release"],
                           cwd=forensic_root,seconds=90,
                           logprefix=forensic_root/"cpp_cmake")
    if compile_config["returncode"]:
        raise CppCoordinateProbeError("C++ scratch diagnostic CMake configuration failed")
    compiled=_invoke(["cmake","--build",str(build),"--target",
                      "cteas_p1_terrain_case","--parallel","2"],
                     cwd=forensic_root,seconds=180,
                     logprefix=forensic_root/"cpp_compile")
    binary=build/"cteas_p1_terrain_case"
    if compiled["returncode"] or not binary.is_file():
        raise CppCoordinateProbeError("native scratch diagnostic C++ compile failed")
    run_dir=forensic_root/"cpp_run"
    run_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    outcsv=run_dir/"unused_trace_only_terrain.csv"
    args=[str(binary),str(selected_tif),str(grid["xrefkm"]),
          str(grid["yrefkm"]),str(grid["nx"]),str(grid["ny"]),
          str(grid["dgridkm"]),str(grid["zone"]),grid["hemisphere"],str(outcsv)]
    status=_invoke(args,cwd=run_dir,seconds=300,
                   logprefix=forensic_root/"cpp_run_log")
    trace=run_dir/"p1_native_cpp_coords.txt"
    if status["returncode"] or not trace.is_file():
        raise CppCoordinateProbeError("native C++ forensic-only execution failed")
    return direct_trace_summary(original_trace=original_trace,cpp_trace=trace,grid=grid)

"""#54 C++ scratch instrumentation/lineage software-only negative fixtures."""
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
import unittest
from scripts.s2g.p1_original_cpp_probe import (
    instrument_cpp,direct_trace_summary,CppCoordinateProbeError,
    HEAD_INCLUDE,TRACE_INIT,TRACE_POINT
)

class DirectCppTraceOnlyTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_scratch_instrumentation_does_not_alter_authoritative_cpp(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            root=Path(td)
            original=root/"terrain_grid.cpp"
            body=HEAD_INCLUDE+"\n"+TRACE_INIT+"\n"+TRACE_POINT+"\n"
            original.write_text(body)
            debug=root/"scratch.cpp"
            instrument_cpp(original,debug)
            self.assertEqual(original.read_text(),body)
            copied=debug.read_text()
            self.assertEqual(copied.count(TRACE_POINT),1)
            self.assertIn("p1_native_cpp_coords.txt",copied)
            self.assertIn("std::setprecision(12)",copied)
            with self.assertRaises(CppCoordinateProbeError):
                instrument_cpp(original,debug)
            original.write_text(HEAD_INCLUDE+"\n"+TRACE_INIT+"\n")
            with self.assertRaises(CppCoordinateProbeError):
                instrument_cpp(original,root/"new.cpp")

    def test_actual_cpp_trace_structural_domain_classification(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            root=Path(td)
            original=root/"fortran_trace.txt"
            cpp=root/"cpp_trace.txt"
            original.write_text("\n".join([
                "1 1 1 2 200.25 400.0",
                "2 1 2 2 300.25 400.0",
                "3 1 -2 2 0.0 400.0",
                "1 2 1 2 200.25 400.0",
                "2 2 2 2 300.25 400.0"
            ])+"\n")
            cpp.write_text("\n".join([
                "1 1 1 1 200.0 399.75", # valid N/S reassignment
                "2 1 2 2 300.0 399.75", # accepted same cell
                "3 1 0 0 0.0 399.75",   # both outside
                "1 2 0 0 200.0 399.75", # original-only
                "2 2 2 2 300.0 399.75",
                "3 2 1 2 200.0 399.75"  # native-only untraced
            ])+"\n")
            grid={"nx":3,"ny":3}
            result=direct_trace_summary(original_trace=original,cpp_trace=cpp,grid=grid)
            self.assertEqual(result["traced_original_pixels"],5)
            self.assertEqual(result["native_total_trace_pixels"],6)
            self.assertEqual(result["different_cells_among_both_inside"],1)
            self.assertEqual(result["model_cell_assignment_axes"],{"NO_E_W/N_S":1})
            self.assertEqual(result["original_inside_only"],1)
            self.assertEqual(result["both_outside"],1)
            self.assertEqual(result["max_abs_original_minus_CXX_easting_m"],.25)
            self.assertEqual(result["max_abs_original_minus_CXX_northing_m"],.25)
            self.assertFalse(result["full_pixel_trace_uploaded"])
            self.assertEqual(result["science_acceptance"],"NOT_ACCEPTED")

    def test_duplicate_source_coordinates_rejected(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            a=Path(td)/"old"
            b=Path(td)/"new"
            a.write_text("1 1 1 1 200 400\n")
            b.write_text("1 1 1 1 200 400\n1 1 1 1 200 400\n")
            with self.assertRaises(CppCoordinateProbeError):
                direct_trace_summary(original_trace=a,cpp_trace=b,grid={"nx":2,"ny":2})

if __name__=="__main__":
    unittest.main()
